findings.description: The `/** Depth-aware link target: `.claude/agents` needs `../.agents/agents`. */` docstring now sits above `claudeAgents` (the new block was inserted between it and `relativeToAgents`), so `claudeAgents` carries two stacked JSDoc blocks and `relativeToAgents` has none; move that line back above `function relativeToAgents`.

The completeness check compares only how many reviewers were spawned and how many returned. A wrong `reviewers_returned` therefore passes as complete when it has duplicates (`["correctness","correctness"]`), names an area that was never spawned, or has more entries than were spawned. A per-area count check would enforce the skill's "by area as in `reviewers_spawned`" contract.

When a record has no findings, an admission in `process_issues` marks it incomplete even if `reviewers_returned` equals `reviewers_spawned`. A complete, clean review whose orchestrator notes an earlier, superseded early emission (or text that matches the regex's "not ... returned" alternative) is then posted red as "Review incomplete".

`render-dir` compares and writes only the files listed in `action.files`, so if a manifest is renamed or removed under `templates/agents/agents/`, its old copy stays in the rendered `.claude/agents/`: Claude Code keeps loading it and `--check` still passes. A symlink could not hold leftovers. Decision 28's "cannot drift unnoticed" overstates the check.

The three agents that get `effort: high` (review-correctness, review-security, review-validator) are listed separately in `CLAUDE_AGENT_FRONTMATTER`, in the pr-ci-review SKILL.md prose, and in `test/init.test.ts`'s loop. Nothing ties the copies together, so a change to the table leaves the skill and the test stale.

Decision 28 amends decision 8, but decision 8's body still says the manifests are "symlinked to Claude Code, opencode, and Cursor" and has no pointer to 28. A one-line "Amended by 28" note on decisions 8 and 21 would keep a reader of either decision from getting a stale picture.

The `/** ... */` block at the top of review-completeness.utils.ts is followed by a blank line and then a `//` comment, so it documents no symbol. Make it a plain module comment or fold its why into `incompleteReason`'s doc.

refuted_findings.description: The workflow puts the `opus`/`sonnet` alias pins in the step `env:`, but its own comment a few lines later says the action does not forward step `env:` to Claude Code. If that comment is right, the pins never take effect and the aliases follow Claude Code's defaults.
refuted_findings.refutation: The comment says the action forwards only the names its own `env:` lists, and claude-code-action's action.yml at the pinned SHA fd1c128 lists both names (lines 370-372: `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL: ${{ env.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL }}`, `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL: ${{ env.ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL }}`), so both pins reach Claude Code. `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS` is not in that list, which is why it goes through `settings`. The two statements are consistent.
